headers.subject: Thanks for applying to Quarry AI

snippet: Hi Mateo, thanks for applying to the Senior Machine Learning Engineer role at Quarry AI. Our recruiting team will review your application and be in touch.
bodyHtml:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for applying to the Senior Machine Learning Engineer role at Quarry AI. We received your application and our recruiting team will review it within the next two weeks.

You can see the posting again here: Senior Machine Learning Engineer.

Quarry AI Recruiting

extraction.summary: Quarry AI confirmed receipt of the Senior Machine Learning Engineer application.
